description: ASEP - Tráfico en minutos de terminales públicos y semipúblicos, Año 2007-2025 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos. Minutos salientes locales, nacionales e internacionales realizados a través de terminales públicos y semipúblicos, Año 2007-2025. (se actualiza anualmente). Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos . Its tags are estadisticas, minutos internacionales, minutos locales, minutos ncionales, semipublicos. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-08-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
